sponsors.name: Trezor
sponsors.description: Trezor makes hardware wallets that keep your Bitcoin private keys offline and secure. Through Trezor Academy, it sponsors Bitcoin education sessions across Kenya. Their support helps us bring practical self-custody skills to everyone who wants to learn.

collaborators.name: Afribit Kibera
collaborators.description: Afribit Kibera is the biggest Bitcoin circular economy in Kenya and the second biggest in Africa, where residents and local businesses earn, spend and save in Bitcoin over the Lightning Network. We collaborate with them to bring Bitcoin education and everyday adoption to local communities.

collaborators.name: Blink
collaborators.description: Blink is a Bitcoin Lightning wallet built for everyday payments, making it simple to send and receive Bitcoin instantly with low fees. It supports Bitcoin communities and circular economies around the world. For our learners and merchants, it is a practical way to take their first steps with Bitcoin.
